$note: Thermal printer + cash drawer config. Change 'printer.type' to switch adapters; see server/services/hardware/adapters/. Use 'noop' for development without hardware — the formatted receipt is logged to the server console.

printer.$interface_notes: type=escpos accepts: tcp://HOST:PORT (network), printer:NAME (Windows spooler), /dev/usb/lp0 or COM1 (serial). For type=noop, interface is ignored.
